senses.gloss: m.ḳ’fiza, name of a small measure (Pers. ḳawij, Greek καπίθη).
units: <cite ref="Menachot 24a:10">Men. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ בקבא</he> if one hollowed out a ḳ. within a kab measure.
<cite ref="Pesachim 48b:2">Pes. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>נהוג למיפא ק׳ ק׳</he> are in the habit of baking only a ḳ. at a time.
<cite ref="Chullin 25a:14">Ḥull. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>חק ק׳ בקבא</he> he hollowed out a ḳ. in a block intended for a kab measure; <cite ref="Shabbat 103a:2">Sabb. 103ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְפִיזֵי</he>.
